jobs.title: HFS Automation Director
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Director of Automation will lead the enterprise automation strategy at Howmet Fastening Systems. This role is responsible for setting the automation vision, standards, governance, technology roadmap, and execution model across multiple manufacturing sites.

The Director of Automation will support site automation engineers as they lead and execute local automation projects. This role will provide strategic direction, technical standards, project review, prioritization support, vendor guidance, and escalation assistance to ensure automation efforts are aligned, scalable, compliant, and delivering measurable business value. This role will also ensure automation strategies are aligned with digital manufacturing and MES requirements, so equipment, operators, materials, quality data, and production records are connected in a consistent and scalable way.

The ideal candidate will combine manufacturing automation expertise, aerospace quality understanding, capital discipline, and strong cross-functional leadership. This person must be able to guide site teams, establish common practices, challenge weak project concepts, and help scale successful solutions across the business.

Essential Responsibilities

Automation Strategy and Roadmap

Develop and maintain a multi-year automation strategy aligned with business growth, capacity, quality, labor productivity, safety, and cost objectives.
Partner with site leadership and site automation engineers to identify, evaluate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
Establish an enterprise automation roadmap that balances local site needs with broader business priorities.
Define which automation solutions should be site-specific, replicated across similar operations, or standardized across the enterprise.
Provide executive-level visibility to automation priorities, risks, investment needs, and performance outcomes.

Automation Standards and Governance

Establish common standards for automation architecture, controls platforms, PLC/HMI/SCADA design, robotics, vision systems, safety systems, equipment documentation, data collection, and integration.
Create standard templates and expectations for project charters, business cases, equipment specifications, design reviews, FAT/SAT, validation, training, and production handoff.
Implement a governance process for automation project intake, prioritization, technical review, approval, and post-launch benefit validation.
Ensure site-led projects follow consistent technical, safety, cybersecurity, quality, and maintainability standards.
Maintain a preferred technology and supplier framework to reduce complexity and improve supportability across sites.

Support for Manufacturing Sites

Serve as the senior technical and strategic resource for site automation engineers leading local projects.
Coach and support site teams during project scoping, concept development, vendor selection, design reviews, risk assessment, launch, and sustainment.
Help sites evaluate automation readiness, including process stability, part variation, labor content, quality risk, maintenance capability, and data requirements.
Provide escalation support for complex automation challenges, vendor issues, technical roadblocks, and cross-functional conflicts.
Facilitate sharing of best practices, lessons learned, and repeatable automation concepts across sites.
Develop a community of practice for site automation engineers and manufacturing engineering leaders.

Manufacturing Automation Guidance

Provide strategic guidance for automation in key fastener manufacturing operations, including heading, forming, thread rolling, machining, grinding, heat treat, coating, inspection, sorting, packaging, and material handling.
Support site teams in applying automation to machine tending, part handling, robotic cells, vision inspection, automated gaging, defect detection, and material movement.
Ensure automation concepts are practical for high-mix aerospace manufacturing environments.
Promote the principle of simplifying, stabilizing, and standardizing processes before automating them.
Identify opportunities to replicate successful automation solutions across similar equipment, products, or processes.

Quality, Compliance, and Risk Management

Ensure automation standards and site-led projects support aerospace quality system requirements, including AS9100 expectations, customer requirements, traceability, change control, and audit readiness.
Partner with Quality, Engineering, and site teams to define requirements for PFMEAs, control plans, validation plans, gage R&R, process capability studies, and production readiness reviews.
Ensure automated inspection and measurement systems are validated, capable, and properly controlled.
Support mistake-proofing, automated inspection, process monitoring, and interlocks to reduce defects and quality escapes.
Ensure automation changes are properly documented and integrated into the quality management system.

Digital Manufacturing and Data Integration

Establish standards for connecting automation equipment with MES, ERP, QMS, SPC, SCADA, machine data systems, and shop-floor dashboards.
Partner with IT and site teams to define requirements for machine connectivity, data collection, cybersecurity, and system integration.
Support digital thread initiatives connecting material, process, inspection, certification, and customer records.
Ensure automation projects generate useful data for OEE, traceability, process monitoring, predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement.
Promote consistent data structures, naming conventions, and reporting methods across sites.

Capital Planning and Business Case Support

Provide guidance to site teams on automation business cases, including payback, labor productivity, capacity improvement, quality savings, scrap reduction, safety improvement, and total cost of ownership.
Support annual and long-range Capex planning by helping prioritize automation investments across the business.
Review major automation proposals for technical feasibility, risk, scalability, maintainability, and financial return.
Track automation project benefits and ensure post-launch results are measured against approved assumptions.
Help identify projects that should be accelerated, replicated, delayed, redesigned, or rejected.

Vendor, Integrator, and Technology Management

Establish preferred vendor, integrator, and technology strategies for the enterprise.
Support site teams in developing scopes of work, equipment specifications, acceptance criteria, FAT/SAT plans, and technical requirements.
Participate in key design reviews and supplier selection decisions for major or strategic automation projects.
Challenge vendor concepts to ensure they are practical, maintainable, safe, scalable, and compliant.
Build relationships with strategic automation partners, machine builders, vision providers, robotics suppliers, and system integrators.

Leadership, Capability Building, and Change Management

Build automation capability across the organization by developing standards, training, tools, and communities of practice.
Mentor site automation engineers, manufacturing engineers, technicians, and maintenance leaders.
Promote consistent project execution methods and disciplined automation deployment.
Partner with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, IT, EHS, Finance, and Supply Chain to align automation efforts.
Support workforce adoption by ensuring operators, supervisors, and maintenance teams are engaged early in automation projects.
Communicate automation strategy, progress, risks, and results to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Automation, Robotics, or related technical field.
10+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, automation, advanced manufacturing, controls, or operations engineering.
5+ years of experience leading automation strategy, capital equipment deployment, manufacturing technology programs, or multi-site automation initiatives.
Experience supporting or leading automation projects in aerospace, defense, precision manufacturing, fasteners, machining, forming, medical device, automotive, or another regulated manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of automation technologies, including robotics, PLCs, HMIs, vision systems, sensors, servos, motion control, safety systems, machine tending, data collection, and material handling.
Experience developing automation standards, equipment specifications, project governance, or preferred technology approaches.
Demonstrated ability to influence and support site-based engineering teams without directly controlling every project.
Experience building or reviewing business cases for automation investments.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to work across operations, engineering, quality, maintenance, IT, EHS, finance, and suppliers.
Experience in aerospace fastener manufacturing or similar high-mix precision component manufacturing.
Knowledge of cold heading, hot forming, thread rolling, machining, grinding, heat treat, coating, plating, inspection, and sorting operations.
Experience with AS9100, NADCAP-related processes, customer audits, FAI, PFMEA, control plans, and aerospace traceability requirements.
Experience integrating automation with MES, ERP, QMS, SPC, SCADA, machine data systems, or digital manufacturing platforms.
Experience developing automation roadmaps across multiple sites or business units.
Knowledge of OEE, TPM, Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, SMED, mistake-proofing, and standard work.
Experience managing strategic vendor and system integrator relationships.
Master’s degree or MBA preferred but not required.

Critical Skills And Knowledge

The Director of Automation should have strong capability in:

Enterprise automation strategy
Multi-site automation governance
Automation standards and architecture
Robotics and machine tending
Vision inspection and automated gaging
PLCs, HMIs, sensors, controls, and safety systems
Material handling and part presentation
Aerospace quality and compliance
Process capability and measurement system validation
Capex planning and ROI analysis
Lean manufacturing and process simplification
MES/ERP/QMS integration
Vendor and integrator management
Coaching and supporting site automation engineers
Scaling best practices across sites

Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

The position includes competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), excellent 401k matching program, paid holidays and vacation. The annual salary range for this position is $200k - 240k.

jobs.description:
Description

Are you a technical leader who thrives on building high-performing engineering teams and shaping the future of software products used by millions? Amazon is looking for a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead multiple software development teams, define multi-year technical strategies, and deliver meaningful outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will own a strategically important software architecture and drive the vision for how multiple systems work together to solve complex customer problems. You will partner with product management, engineering leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to set priorities, remove ambiguity, and ensure your teams are building the right things at the right time. If you are passionate about growing leaders, tackling large-scale technical challenges, and creating an inclusive engineering culture, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

Define and own a multi-year technical strategy for your area, aligning product roadmaps and engineering investments to deliver measurable customer value across multiple software teams.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software development managers and senior engineers, building an inclusive culture where people develop their careers and deliver their best work.
Partner with product management and cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into clear engineering plans, making thoughtful trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.
Establish mechanisms to audit customer experience, operational health, and software quality across your teams, driving continuous improvement in system design, performance, security, and reliability.
Collaborate across organizational boundaries to influence technical direction, resolve prioritization conflicts, and ensure your architecture evolves to meet future business needs at scale.

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing operational metrics and identifying areas that need attention across your teams. Mid-morning, you join a design review with senior engineers to evaluate a proposed architecture change, asking probing questions to ensure scalability and maintainability. After lunch, you meet with peer managers and product leaders to align on quarterly priorities and resolve a resource constraint. Later, you spend time in a one-on-one coaching session with one of your managers, discussing their team's growth plans and career development strategies.

About The Team

The SageMaker HyperPod Infra team is building next-generation AI infrastructure for large-scale training, model customization, and inference. HyperPod is the only AWS service unifying training and inference across Slurm, Kubernetes, and Ray - delivering fault-tolerant infrastructure with sub-2-minute recovery, automated GPU health monitoring, and sophisticated capacity management across thousands of GPU nodes globally. Our team is focused on building AI infra software systems that directly impact how customers experience AI.

Our team values builders who thrive in ambiguity, think long-term, and want to define the future of AI infrastructure. We ship fast, iterate with purpose, and support some of the most demanding AI workloads in the world. We operate in a collaborative environment where engineering leaders work closely with product and business partners to solve complex, high-impact problems. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture where every team member has the opportunity to grow, contribute ideas, and make a real difference. If you're excited to do meaningful work at the frontier of generative AI at massive scale, we'd love to talk.

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Engineering, Adobe Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Intelligence Platform is the foundational AI infrastructure that powers agentic experiences across the Adobe product portfolio. The platform enables interoperability of agents, capabilities, and workflows across the Adobe Creative Cloud, Experience Cloud, Document Clouds, and future product lines. It is transforming Adobe from a suite of best-in-class tools into a unified, AI-native ecosystem.

This platform encompasses agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, skill and capability catalogs, and the planning and reasoning layers that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows at enterprise scale.

We are seeking a Senior Director of Engineering to own the engineering vision and execution of building the Adobe Intelligence Platform. This is a pivotal role to invent, embed, and scale the latest in AI innovation into Adobe’s products. This role is highly visible and key to executing Adobe’s vision to transform the way creators and their teams work and create.

What You Will Do

Define and drive a holistic and full stack engineering strategy for the Adobe Intelligence Platform.
Integrate platform components into web, desktop, and mobile surfaces, partnering with global teams to accelerate their timelines and unify the customer experience.
Grow the organization, including hiring world-class talent, structuring teams, and developing the next generation of AI leaders within Adobe.
Model and drive a new way of working, using the latest AI tooling to plan, review, and ship software.
Own the technology strategy, pairing with senior architects, to define the roadmaps for agentic orchestration, model gateway infrastructure, knowledge graph services, memory systems, AI registries, agentic harnesses, and skill catalogs.
Set and run the operating rhythm with program and product partners: planning, prioritization, cross-team dependencies, and how the org measures its own progress.
Partner with Research and Design to shape the future of applied AI by shortening the loop from cutting edge to production.
Partner with Engineering, Program and Product leaders across the organization to understand their local needs and drive adoption of the AIP platform across Adobe.
Align with Security, Privacy and Legal colleagues to ensure the platform has observability, security, and enterprise governance controls around safety and trust built into the end-to-end architecture.
Define the adoption strategy and own the outcome for partnerships internally: ensure Adobe Intelligence Platform is serving the needs of application teams at all levels and across Adobe’s 3 cloud offering areas.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

12+ years of engineering experience, including significant time leading engineering organizations through ambiguity and change.
Direct experience with platform or infrastructure work: building the layer other engineering teams depend on.
Working fluency in AI/ML systems: evals, context management, model gateways, and adjacent areas.
Technical depth with agentic frameworks and the operational patterns to manage them at scale.
A track record of building or substantially reshaping an engineering org, including hiring, structuring teams, and developing leaders under them.
Comfortable influencing progress with a platform in a shifting technical landscape.
Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive adoption of a platform across global teams.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to inspire teams and express a compelling vision.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Machine Learning
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?
Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television – including TV advertising – around the world, continued success relies on its investment in our machine learning capabilities. Roku offers millions of options to our users: movies, episodes, news, sports, and channels from all around the world. The Roku Content Platform is key to onboarding content into the Roku ecosystem, delighting our customers. Building a content knowledge platform that provides insights to downstream systems like Search, Recommendations, Ads, and Voice to shape customers' experiences is why we're actively looking for a Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineering Manager, Content Platform who can drive further innovation.

What is the role? Roku is seeking a Senior Machine Learning / AI Engineering Manager, Content Platform to lead and advance machine learning capabilities within the Content Platform organization. This role is responsible for defining the ML roadmap, guiding model architecture and MLOps infrastructure, and ensuring that ML systems are scalable and production-ready. The Senior ML / AI Engineering Manager will lead a high-performing team of ML Engineers, driving career development, performance management, and a culture of rigorous experimentation. This individual will partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Content Strategy to align ML initiatives with business goals and deliver measurable improvements to the production environment. The ideal candidate combines deep technical ML expertise with strong organizational leadership, serving as the architectural and operational bridge between AI research and fast-paced product delivery. This role also involves integrating Generative AI capabilities and Vision Models to enrich content quality and user engagement across the Roku ecosystem.

How will I use AI at Roku? At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. Ideally, you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools.

What are the responsibilities of the role? Define and own the roadmap for ML within the Content Platform, establishing a multi-year vision and translating it into iterative delivery cycles
Provide high-level guidance on model architecture and MLOps infrastructure to ensure models are scalable and production-ready
Lead and grow a high-performing team of ML Engineers, including career development, performance management, and fostering a culture of rigorous experimentation
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Content Strategy to align ML initiatives with business goals
Champion a culture of incremental delivery, balancing long-term R&D with the need to ship measurable improvements to the production environment
Integrate Generative AI capabilities and Vision Models to enrich content quality and user engagement

jobs.description:
Job Description

This leader will build the engineering operating model that defines how OCI develops, validates,

and scales new infrastructure technologies from concept through global fleet deployment. The

organization will establish the systems and governance supporting generational design

development, technology roadmap integration, Basis of Design (BOD) management, new

product introduction (NPI), engineering change management, first-of-a-kind (FOAK) validation,

A key responsibility of this organization will be translating OCI's evolving compute, networking,

and AI infrastructure roadmaps into scalable facility engineering solutions. Working closely with

validation strategies, and phased deployment processes before fleet-wide adoption.

This leader will establish repeatable engineering systems that ensure infrastructure designs,

across OCI's global footprint. The organization will develop standardized engineering processes

for technology introduction, engineering change control, design maturity, configuration

management, commissioning, and operational handoff while ensuring engineering decisions are

documented, traceable, and consistently implemented across regions.

The role will drive cross-functional alignment, balancing innovation with standardization to

accelerate deployment velocity while maintaining engineering rigor, operational readiness, and

lifecycle performance.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in engineering operations, critical infrastructure

Define the engineering lifecycle and governance model for successive generations of OCI

Establish stage gates, technical reviews, and engineering readiness criteria from concept

Integrate Architecture, Rack Engineering, Design Engineering, and Product Engineering

roadmaps into future platform development.

Ingest rack technology roadmaps to assess impacts on mechanical, electrical, plumbing,

structural, and controls infrastructure.

Ensure engineering decisions are documented, reviewed, and governed through

standardized development processes while enabling rapid technology adoption.

Establish enterprise engineering change processes and governance for infrastructure

designs, engineering standards, and Basis of Design documentation.

Develop Engineering Change Order (ECO) and Design Change Request (DCR) processes

with clearly defined ownership, approval paths, and implementation requirements.

Evaluate technical, operational, manufacturing, supply chain, schedule, and cost impacts

before changes are implemented.

Ensure engineering changes are scalable across OCI's global fleet and not optimized

solely for individual projects.

Govern implementation of design changes to maintain consistency while accommodating

justified regional requirements.

Develop OCI's engineering systems and governance for introducing new infrastructure

technologies into production.

Define engineering deliverables, qualification requirements, pilot deployments, validation

activities, and production readiness criteria.

Establish structured FOAK evaluation processes and technology readiness assessments

before fleet-wide deployment.

Partner with Design Engineering, OEMs, Product Engineering, and Supply Chain to

influence product selection and ensure alignment with OCI's long-term infrastructure

strategy.

Develop governance for technology transitions, ensuring new products are integrated into

standardized design platforms with minimal operational risk.

Develop engineering validation strategies and governance for new infrastructure

platforms, products, and system architectures.

Establish standardized test strategies including laboratory validation, factory acceptance

testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), integrated systems testing, FOAK

validation, and operational qualification.

Define engineering acceptance criteria and commissioning requirements that ensure

infrastructure is validated before operational handoff.

Standardize commissioning methodologies, documentation, and turnover processes

across OCI's global deployments.

Create feedback mechanisms that incorporate commissioning and operational learnings

into future design generations and engineering standards.

jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for a Director-level candidate to lead a team that provides power systems engineering expertise for off-grid and grid-tied microgrids and data centers. Our projects typically include managing a variety of DER and microgrid assets, including solar, energy storage, switchgear, controls, and reciprocating engines.

You will report to our Chief Technology Officer. This role can be remote, but we have a preference for someone to be close to one of our offices in NY, NJ, or CA.

Key responsibilities will include:
Provide technical expertise to develop core technologies that our project teams will utilize to deliver distributed energy solutions.
Leverage electrical and power engineering knowledge to define best practices and publish internal standards and guidelines to ensure high-quality microgrid projects are engineered well for our clients.
Review project-specific electrical designs and the sequence of operations for controls
Provide technical oversight and guidance on relay protection settings and power systems analysis
Define long-term technical vision and product roadmaps for microgrid design and core technologies.
Work with the business development, execution, and commercial teams to ensure our microgrids are appropriately integrated into the customer site and are technically correct, practical, and cost-effective.
Utilize strong technical and communication skills to interface with all aspects of the business, vendors, and customers.
Support, build, and grow a diverse team.
Provide mentorship and leadership to team members.
Guide individuals in setting clear goals and provide regular feedback on performance to foster career growth.
Coordinate project staffing and prioritization.
Implement new tools and practices as needed to make the team more effective.

The Ideal Candidate

10+ years of power systems experience with 3+ years of experience building and leading technical teams, preferably in a high-growth company.
Thorough technical understanding of distributed energy technologies, including solar, battery, switchgear, and reciprocating engines/turbines.
Understanding of rotating power with reciprocating engines in the 200kW to 5MW size range per engine. This includes parallel operation with the utility and with other DERs, both in grid-parallel and island-mode operations.
Understanding of switchgear and relay protective settings (SEL, Beckwith)
Experience in medium voltage switchgear, including 13.8kV, 23kV, and 34.5kV
Core competency in transformer design, short circuit analysis, grounding schemes, and power systems analysis
Strong knowledge of the various DER power sources within the Microgrid and how they best interface with the utility to provide a more efficient system.
Demonstrated expertise and understanding of the US power markets, the interconnection process, and requirements.
Knowledge of systems controls for all the DERs and how they can be utilized to accomplish specific operating goals while part of the Microgrid.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate with technical and non-technical people to make projects work.
Understanding relevant buildings, electrical, civil, etc., codes is a plus.
BS in Electrical Engineering with a focus on the power side.
PE in power and electrical engineering is preferred.
Experience at an engineering/consulting firm is a plus.
Advanced courses in power or a higher-level degree in the field are preferred.

Scale is redefining resilience, with advanced microgrids that go beyond traditional backup power solutions to give businesses the power to adapt and thrive amid all of today’s growing energy challenges. As a vertically-integrated provider of turnkey advanced microgrid systems, Scale combines project design, engineering, and execution expertise with microgrid-as-a-service financing to offer our customers systems that are optimized to deliver maximum value from day one while ensuring ultra-reliable operations and fast time-to-power.

jobs.title: Director, Server Platform & Systems Validation Engineering
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

The Role: 

As AMD grows, growing our leadership in systems engineering expertise is essential for all the new products in the AMD pipeline. Want to translate business goals into cutting-edge product and system features that meet those requirements? Make a significant impact in AMD’s Server business and the direction of the Data Center industry through this new, high-visibility role! 

The leader of the Server Platform and Systems Engineering team advises our strategy, partnerships, engineering development teams, and global system development, system solutions, and customer engineering teams to deliver new and innovative system features to AMD product and systems. Lead forward looking, leadership capabilities into our products, software, firmware, ecosystem, and ultimately, shipping customer server systems. Drive cohesive strategy and plans, hire teams, and deliver innovation in the area of data center capabilities and user features.  

The Person: 

Seeking a strong technical leader who has worked in the semiconductor or systems industry with experience in post-silicon validation of server CPUs, enterprise class servers, and large-scale clusters. You enjoy developing talent and growing best in class teams. In addition, you are a change agent with a proven record of pushing the boundary of validation and driving validation innovation. You possess strong interpersonal skills and excellent communication skills. You thrive on collaboration and solving complex organization challenges.

The Role

You will be part of the Server Platform and Systems Engineering Validation team reporting to the Senior Director of Functional Validation team. You will get the opportunity to lead the Systems/Platform team as they collaborate with Silicon Designers/Architects, Firmware, Core Functional Validation, Software and Customer Engineering teams to bring our products to market. You will have the latitude to innovate and be a change leader. Our Server CPU business is the fastest growing within the company and in the computing industry at large. This will be a very visible role which will provide you an opportunity to grow your career and interact with AMD's senior leadership team.

Technical Leadership role responsible for leading various teams that own System Level validation and other validation functions for our next generation EPYC server CPU products. You will lead a team comprising of Principal Member of Technical Staff, Sr. Managers and other key technical leads The work will require interlock with other engineering and business. The role covers CPU post-si validation planning to silicon Bring-up through production. Role is a large cross-functional role requiring technical depth/breadth and strong leadership skills. jobs.title: Director, Data & Storage Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role:

Team Management

The successful candidate will lead the Data & Storage Reliability Engineering organization responsible for improving reliability, resilience, performance, scalability, observability, and customer experience across ServiceNow's database, storage, and supporting platform infrastructure.

This leader will be responsible for building, developing, and scaling high-performing engineering teams focused on reliability engineering, observability, performance engineering, diagnostics, automation, production analytics, migration readiness, resilience engineering, and prevention engineering.

Responsibilities include talent acquisition, performance management, career development, succession planning, objective setting, coaching, and prioritization of strategic initiatives.

The role will establish a strong engineering-first culture centered on data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, operational excellence, customer experience, and systemic risk reduction.

This position is accountable for identifying recurring failure patterns, reliability risks, performance bottlenecks, scalability constraints, migration challenges, and operational inefficiencies across database services, storage platforms, cloud infrastructure, and distributed application environments, and driving engineering improvements that eliminate entire classes of issues before they impact customers.

The Director will partner closely with Product Engineering, Database Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Architecture, Storage Engineering, Support, and Operations teams to ensure reliability, observability, performance, and resilience considerations are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate will also partner closely with SWAT and Customer & Production Engineering teams to establish a continuous feedback loop between production operations and platform improvement. SWAT remains responsible for customer escalations, production operations, incident response, and service restoration, while this organization is responsible for identifying systemic opportunities, defining engineering priorities, and driving platform improvements that reduce future customer impact.

The successful candidate will serve as the senior technical leader for complex reliability investigations, customer-critical escalation reviews, migration readiness assessments, and platform improvement initiatives, transforming production insights into long-term engineering outcomes.

They will influence architectural decisions and technology investments by providing reliability expertise, observability insights, performance guidance, and production-based evidence that improve platform resilience, scalability, efficiency, and customer outcomes.

This role requires a strong product mindset. The leader will treat reliability, observability, resilience, performance, and automation capabilities as products with roadmaps, priorities, adoption goals, and measurable outcomes. They will be responsible for identifying the highest-value engineering opportunities, prioritizing investments, and driving adoption across multiple product and infrastructure organizations.

Process and Procedures

The successful candidate will establish scalable reliability engineering practices, standards, governance processes, and operating models across the organization.

They will drive adoption of observability standards, reliability engineering frameworks, resiliency assessments, migration readiness practices, diagnostics capabilities, engineering guardrails, and automation strategies.

This leader will continuously evaluate incidents, customer escalations, migration outcomes, platform telemetry, performance trends, capacity signals, and operational data to identify systemic risks and drive long-term engineering improvements.

The role will establish a formal review process with SWAT and Customer & Production Engineering teams to evaluate major incidents, recurring operational challenges, migration learnings, customer-impacting events, and emerging platform risks. These insights will be used to prioritize engineering investments and platform improvements.

The successful candidate will establish meaningful KPIs and engineering metrics that provide visibility into platform reliability, resiliency, performance, operational efficiency, customer experience, engineering productivity, and risk reduction.

The successful candidate will leverage AI-powered tools, analytics, automation frameworks, and production intelligence to identify emerging risks, improve detection coverage, accelerate engineering insights, reduce operational toil, and improve engineering productivity.

They will use production telemetry, incident learnings, customer escalations, migration outcomes, observability data, and operational trends to drive architectural improvements, reliability investments, platform standards, and long-term engineering evolution.

The Director will maintain a portfolio of reliability investments spanning observability, performance, diagnostics, resilience, automation, and prevention, balancing immediate customer needs with long-term platform strategy.

The Director will champion a proactive reliability engineering model that shifts the organization from reactive issue response toward predictive analysis, prevention, resilience, and continuous optimization.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
Strong product mindset with demonstrated experience treating technical capabilities as products with roadmaps, priorities, customers, adoption goals, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience translating production insights, customer pain points, operational challenges, reliability risks, and platform telemetry into prioritized engineering investments and long-term roadmaps.
Experience partnering closely with production operations, customer escalation teams, reliability organizations, and software engineering teams to drive systemic improvements based on operational learnings.
Experience defining product strategies, developing roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning stakeholders across multiple organizations without direct authority.
Experience operating a portfolio of engineering investments, balancing short-term customer needs with long-term reliability, performance, scalability, and resilience objectives.
15+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, database engineering, distributed systems, product management, or large-scale SaaS environments.
8+ years of engineering leadership experience, including leading managers and globally distributed teams.
Extensive experience leading Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, Database Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Production Engineering, Performance Engineering, or related technical organizations.
Deep expertise in distributed systems, databases, storage technologies, cloud infrastructure, and large-scale SaaS architectures.
Strong understanding of reliability engineering principles, observability, scalability, resiliency, operational excellence, and performance engineering.
Experience building and operating observability, telemetry, diagnostics, reliability, or performance capabilities at scale.
Proven experience identifying systemic issues and converting operational insights into strategic engineering improvements.
Experience partnering closely with Product Management organizations to influence roadmaps and deliver customer-centric outcomes.
Experience driving engineering initiatives through data, metrics, customer impact analysis, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience leveraging AI technologies to improve decision-making, analytics, engineering workflows, operational efficiency, reliability insights, automation, or customer outcomes.
Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Skills

Previous Product Management experience in a platform, infrastructure, cloud, database, storage, or SaaS environment.
Experience applying product management disciplines such as roadmap planning, prioritization, customer-centric thinking, outcome measurement, and portfolio management to engineering organizations.
Experience operating large-scale enterprise database and storage platforms supporting mission-critical workloads.
Experience building and scaling Reliability Engineering, Performance Engineering, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Production Engineering organizations.
Experience with observability platforms, telemetry systems, diagnostics frameworks, and production analytics.
Experience with migration readiness, resiliency validation, reliability testing, operational risk reduction, and large-scale cloud transformations.
Experience leveraging AI technologies to improve anomaly detection, forecasting, incident analysis, prioritization, and engineering productivity.
Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, cloud platform operations, and hyperscale environments.
Experience developing executive-facing reliability scorecards, engineering metrics, and business impact reporting.
Experience influencing platform architecture, database strategy, storage strategy, and long-term engineering roadmaps.
Experience with Linux-based production environments and large-scale cloud infrastructure.
Experience supporting enterprise database technologies such as MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server, or cloud-native database platforms.
Familiarity with ServiceNow platform architecture and large-scale SaaS operations.

You’ll guide the product creation process through optimal engineering, manage fit expectations, and deliver excellence across all genders. We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Develop scalable and sustainable engineering infrastructure to balance team capacity and demand, formalizing processes as guardrails around an entrepreneurial creation process.

MS or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related Engineering fields (or equivalent experience).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure provides organizations around the world with computing infrastructure and software to help them innovate, unlock efficiencies, and operate more effectively.
As Senior Director, Robotics, you will lead a high-impact organization responsible for advancing Oracle’s robotics strategy and delivering the technical, operational, and organizational capabilities required to deploy and manage robotic systems at scale. You will partner across applied science, engineering, product, hardware, security, operations, legal, finance, and executive leadership to translate customer and business needs into secure, reliable, and commercially viable robotics solutions.
You will lead teams building production-ready robotics capabilities across perception, sensor fusion, multimodal AI, embodied AI, robot planning, mission execution, telemetry, digital twins, device management, and cloud services. This role requires strong judgment across hardware and software boundaries, the ability to balance scientific innovation with operational rigor, and accountability for delivering scalable robotics platforms that create measurable customer and business value.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership: Set the scientific and technical direction for robotics, perception, and embodied AI initiatives. Collaborate with executive leadership to align product vision, applied research priorities, resource allocation, and delivery roadmaps.
Applied Research and Innovation: Lead teams of scientists, data engineers, machine learning engineers, and developers in applied research programs spanning multi-sensor fusion, real-time signals, perception systems, multimodal reasoning, reinforcement learning, planning, and decision-making.
Robotics Technology Development: Drive development and deployment of AI capabilities for robotic systems and related cloud services, including data collection, model architecture, training, evaluation, inference design, API integration, observability, and production monitoring.
Solution Identification and Prioritization: Partner with science, engineering, product, and hardware leaders to identify product needs where robotics and embodied AI can create measurable customer and business impact. Prioritize opportunities using feasibility, scientific rigor, customer impact, and risk/reward tradeoffs.
Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration: Foster productive collaboration between applied science, software engineering, machine learning engineering, product management, hardware teams, operations, and go-to-market stakeholders. Encourage knowledge sharing and joint problem-solving across disciplines.
Product Innovation: Translate scientific advances into practical, scalable, and marketable capabilities. Ensure delivered solutions are competitive, reliable, and aligned with customer needs and cloud service requirements.
Data, Evaluation, and Insights: Define dataset strategy, data quality standards, labeling approaches, synthetic or simulation data opportunities, evaluation protocols, product metrics, and operational feedback loops that guide technical decisions and future strategy.
Production Readiness and Quality Assurance: Establish standards for reliability, latency, robustness, safety, security, testing, documentation, code review, and deployment readiness. Serve as an escalation point for complex robotics, AI, perception, and systems integration issues.
Technical Leadership and Talent Development: Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop senior scientists and engineers. Raise the bar for applied research rigor, engineering quality, full-stack delivery, and executive-level communication.
Intellectual Property, Ecosystem Awareness, and Portfolio Management: Identify opportunities for patents, publications, white papers, demos, and reusable patterns. Stay current on robotics platforms, commercial robot APIs and SDKs, benchmarks, customer feedback, and competitive offerings while managing budgets and portfolio priorities.

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years of experience in robotics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, computer vision, perception, signal processing, statistical modeling, data mining, software engineering, or a related field; or equivalent degree-based experience in a relevant technical discipline.
Demonstrated experience leading applied science, research, machine learning, or engineering teams through complex technical programs from ambiguous problem framing through production delivery.
Proven ability to guide high-complexity technical decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and communicate robotics and AI strategy to executive, technical, product, and cross-functional audiences.
Experience delivering AI, robotics, perception, embodied AI, or multimodal systems into production, customer-facing, or operational environments.

Preferred Skills And Experience

Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field is preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading research and development efforts within cloud services, AI platforms, robotics, embodied AI, computer vision, perception, or related technology organizations.
Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, including experience leading cross-functional teams, developing senior technical talent, and driving successful multi-team programs.
Strong business acumen and ability to align scientific efforts with company strategy, market demand, product priorities, customer impact, and budget constraints.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to diagnose production issues, improve observability and reliability, and guide durable root-cause solutions.
Experience creating patents, technical publications, white papers, peer-reviewed articles, design documents, or equivalent technical documentation.
Hands-on or leadership experience with commercial robot platforms, robot SDKs/APIs, simulation environments, telemetry systems, real-time constraints, and safety or reliability requirements.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities, customer needs, and emerging technology opportunities.

Success Profile

Builds credibility as a senior applied science leader who can bridge research depth with pragmatic product delivery.
Operates comfortably across sensors, models, APIs, hardware/software boundaries, cloud services, and executive decision-making forums.
Raises the bar for AI adoption in robotics by creating reusable patterns, evaluation standards, and scalable delivery practices.

jobs.title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to help shape the future of Commerce at Venmo.

Millions of people already use Venmo to pay businesses, whether they’re paying a local business in the Venmo app or using Pay with Venmo at checkout. And we believe there’s a much bigger opportunity ahead.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

Manages multiple projects through direct reports and may directly manage individual software development projects. Ensures project delivery through supervision of costs, methods, and staffing
Sets operational targets that impact their group and drives operational rigor around engineering KPIs such as unit test coverage, uptime/resiliency targets, execution velocity
Responsible for the delivery of projects and continuous improvement that impact up to three domains
Leads the effort in resolving highly complex or unique technical situations that impact business success or addresses future concepts, products, or technologies
Creates the roadmap for multiple scrum teams. Responsible for turning a high-level operational strategy into a well-defined resourcing plan
Demonstrates perseverance in pursuing difficult, complex, or ambiguous goals or problems, applying advanced analytical thought and judgment.
Collaborates with direct team, managers in org, stakeholders, managers in other orgs and business stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications:

8+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience leading others

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Venmo has always made payments between people simple and social. We want to bring more of that experience to commerce, making it easier for customers to discover and pay businesses they care about, and giving merchants better ways to reach and engage Venmo customers.

You’ll own engineering for a big part of that experience. You’ll partner closely with Product and Design to define what we build, set the technical direction with your engineering team, and turn ideas into products that operate at Venmo scale.

This isn’t a role where everything is already mapped out. We have clear business goals and a strong foundation, but there are still important product and technical questions to answer. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable with that ambiguity and wants to help chart the course.

What You’ll Do

Lead and develop an engineering team responsible for building and scaling Venmo Commerce products used by millions of customers and businesses
Partner closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and business teams to identify customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn ideas into products
Own the technical direction for your area, working with senior engineers and architects to make decisions that balance speed, simplicity, reliability, and long-term scale
Build a strong team through hiring, coaching, regular feedback, career development, and thoughtful organizational design
Give engineers clear ownership and the context and autonomy to make good decisions
Drive execution across complex initiatives, identify risks early, and help the team navigate dependencies and changing priorities
Maintain a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, security, and operational excellence
Make thoughtful trade-offs when there isn’t an obvious answer and communicate those decisions clearly
Work across Venmo and PayPal when solving problems that span products, platforms, or organizations
Build a culture where people challenge assumptions, learn quickly, take ownership, and care deeply about the customer experience
Help the team use AI effectively in how we build software, from development and testing to debugging and operations, while applying good judgment about where AI adds value and where it doesn’t

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience leading software engineering teams and delivering complex products at scale
A track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams
Strong technical judgment. You don’t need to be writing code every day, but you should be able to go deep when needed, ask the right questions, and guide teams through difficult architecture and engineering decisions
Experience building large-scale distributed systems and familiarity with modern mobile, web, and backend architectures
Experience taking products or major capabilities from idea through launch, iteration, and scale
Strong product instincts and a customer-first mindset. You think about the problem we’re solving before the technology we’re using to solve it
AI fluency and hands-on experience using modern AI tools in software development. You understand their strengths and limitations and can help a team adopt them thoughtfully to improve engineering velocity and quality
Comfort operating in ambiguity, bringing structure to complex problems, and adjusting as customer and business priorities evolve
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to build trust with Product, Design, business, and engineering partners
Clear communication and the ability to explain complex technical decisions to different audiences
A consistent track record of delivering on commitments without sacrificing engineering quality or the health of the team

Nice to Have

Experience with payments, fintech, or other highly available financial systems
Experience building consumer products at significant scale
Background in commerce, marketplaces, social products, or platform businesses
Experience building products or tools for merchants and small businesses
Experience working in both fast-moving and large-scale engineering environments
Experience leading teams across multiple locations or time zones

PayPal

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Our Benefits:

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health.

jobs.description:

Department:

Description

The Vice President of Technology & Innovation is responsible for defining ITC's technology direction and ensuring the company remains ahead of changes in technology, platforms, automation, and AI as ITC scales toward $100M and beyond.

This leader owns ITC's technology strategy, architecture, platform direction, AI and automation strategy, technical innovation, and technology lifecycle. The VP works across departments to turn emerging technology and technical expertise into scalable capabilities, standards, automation, and competitive advantages for ITC and its clients.

This is not a day-to-day delivery or escalation role. The VP of Technology & Innovation is responsible for determining where ITC is going technologically and building the capabilities required to get there.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technology Strategy & Roadmap

Develop and own ITC's company-wide technology strategy and multi-year technology roadmap.
Translate company growth objectives into technology priorities, investments, and capabilities.
Identify technologies ITC should adopt, standardize, consolidate, or retire.
Maintain visibility into major technology trends and their potential impact on ITC and its clients.
Establish clear annual and quarterly technology priorities with measurable outcomes.
Advise the COO and executive leadership on technology opportunities, risks, investments, and strategic decisions.

2. Technology Standards & Architecture

Establish ITC's technical architecture and approved technology direction across core technology disciplines.
Partner with Proactive Services to translate architecture and technical direction into measurable client standards and controls.
Establish reference architectures, approved technology stacks, platform requirements, and lifecycle strategies.
Coordinate designated SMEs and technical experts across the organization to establish technical direction.
Establish governance for architecture decisions, technology exceptions, and new technology adoption.
Ensure lessons learned from systemic technical issues result in improved architecture, standards, documentation, or automation.
Ensure ITC's technical strategy remains scalable, supportable, secure, and commercially viable.

3. AI, Automation & Innovation

Own ITC's enterprise AI, automation, and innovation strategy.
Lead the AI and Automation team and establish a prioritized company-wide roadmap.
Identify opportunities across Operations, Client Success, Revenue, Finance, and other departments where AI and automation can materially improve performance.
Establish measurable business cases and ROI expectations for significant initiatives.
Drive automation of repetitive processes, technical controls, reporting, integrations, and workflows.
Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine where ITC should invest, experiment, scale, or avoid.
Create a disciplined process for moving ideas from concept to pilot to measurable result to standardization and scale.
Ensure innovation efforts remain focused on measurable business outcomes rather than technology for technology's sake.

4. Technology Platforms & Product Evolution

Own the strategic technology roadmap for major technology platforms assigned to the Technology organization.
Ensure platform capabilities, architecture, integrations, reliability, scalability, and lifecycle align with ITC's long-term strategy.
Evaluate new capabilities, vendors, integrations, and technologies that can improve or differentiate ITC's service offerings.
Partner with Revenue, Client Success, and Operations to translate technology capabilities into scalable client offerings.
Ensure platform strategy and innovation remain connected to client demand, competitive positioning, and financial performance.
Maintain clear separation between platform ownership and expertise within Technology and implementation/service delivery within Operations.

5. Technology Enablement & Organizational Partnership

Provide Operations with the architecture, standards, tooling, automation, and technical enablement required to execute consistently.
Partner with the Director of Proactive Services to establish the technical foundation supporting client technology-health standards and controls.
Provide Client Success and vCIOs with technical direction, lifecycle requirements, and architecture needed to develop effective client technology roadmaps.
Partner with Cybersecurity to ensure technology architecture and innovation align with security requirements.
Develop technical enablement, documentation, and knowledge-transfer processes that increase the capabilities of ITC's delivery teams.
Establish a clear process for systemic, architectural, and platform-level technical escalations without allowing Technology to become another service desk.
Break down cross-department barriers that prevent technology initiatives from being implemented successfully.

6. Lead, Manage, and Accountability

Lead, manage, and develop the Technology & Innovation organization.
Provide leadership and accountability for the Director of ITC Cloud, AI/Automation team, and designated technology architecture/SME resources.
Establish clear roles, ownership, scorecards, KPIs, priorities, and operating rhythms.
Hold technology leaders and assigned SMEs accountable for measurable outcomes.
Develop future technology leaders and establish succession plans for critical technical capabilities.
Build a culture of ownership, innovation, standardization, continuous improvement, and execution.
Build the organization deliberately, leveraging existing talent and automation before adding unnecessary headcount.
Ensure Technology & Innovation produces measurable value for ITC rather than becoming a research or escalation function.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The Vice President of Technology & Innovation provides leadership and accountability for:

Internal Operations -
Internal IT, company systems, business applications, infrastructure, integrations, and internal technology support.

Cybersecurity -
Cybersecurity team, security operations, tooling, vulnerability management, and incident response.

AI & Automation -
Enterprise AI, automation, integrations, and workflow development.

Technology Architecture / SMEs -
Technical architecture, technology stack, standards, and platform expertise.

Role Boundaries

The Vice President of Technology & Innovation owns technology strategy, technology stack and systems, architecture, AI and automation, internal technology, cybersecurity, and innovation.

This role does not own Service Delivery, Project Delivery, routine client remediation, vCIO/client relationship management, or AC&S delivery.

This role works closely with Operations, Proactive Services, Client Success, vCIO, and Revenue teams to ensure technology strategy is effectively translated into execution and client outcomes.

Qualifications & Experience

8+ years of progressive technology experience, preferably within an MSP, technology services, cloud communications, SaaS, or similar environment.
3+ years of technical leadership experience.
Broad understanding of cloud, Microsoft technologies, networking, communications/UCaaS, cybersecurity, AI, automation, and managed-services technologies.
Experience developing technology strategy, architecture, platforms, or technical standards.
Demonstrated experience evaluating and implementing emerging technologies.
Strong understanding of AI, automation, APIs, integrations, and modern technology platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Embedded Imaging Software
jobs.description:
What does every robot need before it can reason or act? It needs to see. As robotics evolves from hand-engineered algorithms to learned AI policies, imaging becomes a central part of the end-to-end intelligence loop. This shift calls for a new camera stack that delivers synchronized, low-latency, model-ready data from sensor to tensor.

As a Senior Software Manager at NVIDIA, you’ll lead this transformation for our Jetson platform. You’ll define and deliver our imaging software roadmap while coordinating engineers and managers building camera drivers, image-processing algorithms, streaming frameworks, and developer tools. Together, we’ll help customers move from prototype to production and shape how the next generation of humanoids and autonomous machines perceives the world. Come build the eyes of physical AI!

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead delivery of emerging sensing and imaging technologies into our Jetson BSP across drivers, algorithms, frameworks, agents, and skills
Support a team transitioning to an agentic development workflow that improves execution velocity, transparency, software quality, and system performance
Translate customer and ecosystem requirements into prioritized capabilities and measurable product outcomes
Align engineering efforts between software and partner teams in imaging research, tuning, Jetson product, hardware, and QA to ship features into releases on a predictable schedule
Develop and mentor engineering managers and senior technical leaders while crafting opportunities for the broader team to grow

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ overall years of relevant software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading software teams, along with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience developing embedded Linux software for systems-on-chip with modern agentic workflows, including device drivers, platform bring-up, and debugging on target hardware
Technical depth in C, C++, or Rust systems software, with the ability to guide architecture, performance optimization, and system-level debugging
Proven ability to translate market requirements into software roadmaps and align interdisciplinary, matrixed teams to deliver results
Hands-on development experience with modern agentic tools, skills, and workflows

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Knowledge of embedded camera technologies, such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Camera over Ethernet, V4L2, ISP control, or image quality tuning
Taken edge AI systems from concept to production, especially in robotics
Experience building agentic skills or AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and software quality
Familiarity with functional-safety development practices, such as ISO 26262 or IEC 61508
Understanding of input requirements and image quality dependencies for VLMs, VLAs, and other perception models

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package (www.nvidiabenefits.com ), we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.
