new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Embedded Imaging Software
new_jobs.description:
What does every robot need before it can reason or act? It needs to see. As robotics evolves from hand-engineered algorithms to learned AI policies, imaging becomes a central part of the end-to-end intelligence loop. This shift calls for a new camera stack that delivers synchronized, low-latency, model-ready data from sensor to tensor.

As a Senior Software Manager at NVIDIA, you’ll lead this transformation for our Jetson platform. You’ll define and deliver our imaging software roadmap while coordinating engineers and managers building camera drivers, image-processing algorithms, streaming frameworks, and developer tools. Together, we’ll help customers move from prototype to production and shape how the next generation of humanoids and autonomous machines perceives the world. Come build the eyes of physical AI!

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead delivery of emerging sensing and imaging technologies into our Jetson BSP across drivers, algorithms, frameworks, agents, and skills
Support a team transitioning to an agentic development workflow that improves execution velocity, transparency, software quality, and system performance
Translate customer and ecosystem requirements into prioritized capabilities and measurable product outcomes
Align engineering efforts between software and partner teams in imaging research, tuning, Jetson product, hardware, and QA to ship features into releases on a predictable schedule
Develop and mentor engineering managers and senior technical leaders while crafting opportunities for the broader team to grow

What We Need To See

BS or MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
10+ overall years of relevant software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading software teams, along with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
Experience developing embedded Linux software for systems-on-chip with modern agentic workflows, including device drivers, platform bring-up, and debugging on target hardware
Technical depth in C, C++, or Rust systems software, with the ability to guide architecture, performance optimization, and system-level debugging
Proven ability to translate market requirements into software roadmaps and align interdisciplinary, matrixed teams to deliver results
Hands-on development experience with modern agentic tools, skills, and workflows

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Knowledge of embedded camera technologies, such as MIPI CSI, GMSL, Camera over Ethernet, V4L2, ISP control, or image quality tuning
Taken edge AI systems from concept to production, especially in robotics
Experience building agentic skills or AI-assisted workflows that improve engineering efficiency and software quality
Familiarity with functional-safety development practices, such as ISO 26262 or IEC 61508
Understanding of input requirements and image quality dependencies for VLMs, VLAs, and other perception models

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package (www.nvidiabenefits.com ), we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD for Level 4, and 320,000 USD - 488,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 6, 2026.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Our goal is to have the senior manager capable of managing highly talented engineers concentrated in Nashville in a high paced environment, to develop world class software. Senior manager needs to be hands-on and able to build and understand code. Growth in this role means being able to deliver results in a timely manner, assessing risks and defining a mitigation plan, and making sure the deliverables are of the highest quality. The primary focus for this position will be on Operating Systems (kernel, uboot, firmware), robotic (ROS2/DDS), assurance (IMA, TPM, Veraison), Security (Verified Boot, SecureBoot).

This is an opportunity to lead teams building software that directly improves how OCI supports global data center infrastructure, reduces operational friction, increases automation, and enables OCI to scale efficiently.

This role works closely with product, infrastructure, security, hardware, and platform teams, as well as external silicon and hardware vendors. You will be deeply hands-on, working on early prototypes through production-ready platform software and technical standards.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Lead, grow, and develop high-performing software engineering teams responsible for Trusted Robot Platforms.
Own the design, delivery, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of software services used to support the long-term the robot platforms.
Partner with product managers, technical program managers, operations leaders, and engineering stakeholders to define roadmaps, prioritize investments, and deliver high-impact software.
Establish strong engineering practices around architecture, service ownership, observability, testing, deployment, security, incident response, and operational readiness.
Lead teams through the full software lifecycle, including requirements definition, technical design, implementation, launch, production operations, and continuous improvement.
Mentor and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and senior engineers through coaching, feedback, career development, and performance management.
Recruit, hire, and retain strong engineering talent while building a culture of ownership, inclusion, technical excellence, and customer focus.
Drive cross-functional alignment across complex technical and organizational boundaries, making clear trade-offs between speed, quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
Use metrics, analytics, and operational feedback to continuously improve software quality, system performance, user experience, and business outcomes.
Participate in operational reviews, customer escalations, roadmap discussions, and technical deep dives as needed to ensure services meet high standards for availability and effectiveness.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Capacity Ingestion and Management:

Supports team members designing and architecting infrastructure and/or service, sharing guidance on practices and terms for reliability and functionality.
Supervises team members and provides direction to ensure accurate forecasting of demands for infrastructure and response to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps.
Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements.
Implements expectations for identifying opportunities for prototyping and manages prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches.

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:

Monitors data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection, ensuring team members maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
Provides support to team members monitoring services, ensuring they maintain up-to-date knowledge of performance and document their condition.
Leverages advanced knowledge to aid team members in performing incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery).
Monitors comprehensive health and performance reporting and ensures team members take appropriate actions based on trends in data.
Ensures team members adhere to procedures when performing provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services.
Encourages team members to experiment with new approaches for and perform decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.

Automation:

Implements standards for identifying and recommending opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency.
Takes a proactive role in reviewing and offering feedback on design, automation tools, or scripts, acting as a leader during implementation.
Shares strategies for conducting testing on automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results.

Technical Communication and Guidance:

Reviews and provides feedback on release notes and ensures team members communicate comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams.
Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations.
Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate.

Troubleshooting and Resolution:

Serves as a senior management escalation point for incidents and complex issues arising within Oracle services.
Monitors the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, ensuring effective investigation and debugging techniques are leveraged to achieve SLOs (service level objectives).
Shares expectations for documenting incidents performing root cause analyses, guiding team members to capture essential information for analysis and future reference.
Implements guidelines for post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.
Ensures team members adhere to service level agreements (SLAs) made with customers.

Innovation and Improvement:

Sets expectations for conducting experiments and evaluating cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards.
Manages and contributes to the prioritization of initiatives to improve performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability.
Implements standards for developing and maintaining knowledge of site reliability trends and sharing valuable insights and information with team members, management, and beyond to promote innovative building, testing, deploying, and running services.
Leverages analyses and data from teams to contribute to business development decisions (e.g., design changes).

Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

Continuous Learning:

Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

Continuous Improvement:

Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Marketing Technology
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

This leader owns the technical execution of a portfolio of marketing applications, shared services, integrations, automation, and data-enabled capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of marketing, product, data, and engineering and is responsible for translating business problems into scalable technical solutions rather than simply administering individual marketing platforms.

The Senior Manager leads both people and technology: establishing engineering practices, guiding solution architecture, developing technical talent, managing the application roadmap, and ensuring the team's products are secure, reliable, interoperable, measurable, and maintainable.

Responsibilities

Technology Leadership & Strategy

Lead the MarTech engineering function and establish the technical strategy for internally developed marketing applications, integrations, automation, and shared services.
Translate marketing and demand-generation requirements into scalable application, data, integration, and workflow architectures.
Partner with business and technology leaders to determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, extended, automated, or retired.
Drive a modular architecture that enables common capabilities and data to be reused across applications rather than repeatedly implemented within individual tools.
Establish technical standards for application development, APIs, integrations, data models, identity and access, observability, release management, and documentation.
Maintain a pragmatic technical roadmap balancing business value, platform sustainability, technical debt, security, and engineering capacity.

Application & Platform Ownership

Provide technical leadership for marketing applications and operational platforms supporting demand planning, campaign execution, program and event management, customer engagement, nominations, account intelligence, workflow, reporting, and automation.
Guide the evolution of applications from isolated tools toward interoperable services and shared platform capabilities.
Ensure common business entities, including accounts, contacts, programs, events, campaigns, opportunities, users, and marketing activities, are consistently represented and reusable across systems.
Lead integration with enterprise systems and data sources including CRM, account and contact data, commercial pipeline, financial data, analytics platforms, and identity services.
Establish appropriate system-of-record boundaries and controlled read/write integration patterns.
Oversee production reliability, application lifecycle management, upgrades, technical debt remediation, and operational support.

Engineering Leadership

Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of MarTech engineers.
Provide technical direction while maintaining enough technical depth to review architecture, challenge design decisions, and unblock complex engineering problems.
Establish development practices covering source control, testing, code review, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and documentation.
Improve engineering velocity through reusable patterns, frameworks, shared services, and automation.
Establish clear ownership across applications, services, integrations, and data products.
Drive disciplined prioritization and prevent one-off solutions from creating unnecessary application or integration sprawl.

Data, Integration & Automation

Lead design of reliable integrations between marketing systems and enterprise platforms.
Drive API-first and reusable integration patterns where appropriate rather than point-to-point solutions.
Partner with data teams to establish canonical objects, source mappings, identity resolution, and trustworthy data flows.
Implement automation that removes manual reconciliation, duplicate data entry, spreadsheet coordination, and unnecessary human handoffs.
Ensure integrations include appropriate validation, monitoring, failure handling, lineage, ownership, and auditability.
Support the creation of governed data services that can be reused across operational applications, reporting, analytics, and AI.

AI & Emerging Technology

Identify practical opportunities to apply AI to marketing operations, application experiences, workflow automation, decision support, and engineering productivity.
Establish patterns for permission-aware and evidence-grounded AI capabilities rather than disconnected AI experiments.
Partner with security, data, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions operate within appropriate data-access and audit controls.
Evaluate emerging technology based on measurable business value, maintainability, interoperability, and risk.

Security, Governance & Reliability

Partner with security and identity teams to implement enterprise authentication, authorization, role-based and attribute-based access, service identities, and audit controls.
Ensure applications appropriately protect customer, employee, commercial, and financial information.
Establish technical governance without creating unnecessary delivery bureaucracy.
Ensure systems include production monitoring, integration health, data freshness, error detection, and support runbooks.
Maintain clear technical documentation and architectural decision records.

Business Partnership

Serve as the senior technical partner to marketing operations, campaign services, field marketing, analytics, business architecture, and related organizations.
Translate ambiguous business problems into structured technical requirements and solution options.
Challenge requirements where simpler, reusable, or more sustainable solutions exist.
Communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineering and non-technical audiences.
Partner with product and business owners to define measurable outcomes and adoption expectations for technology investments.

Qualifications

Required

8+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise applications, marketing technology, data platforms, or related technical disciplines.
3+ years leading engineers or technical teams.
Demonstrated experience designing and delivering enterprise applications or platforms used by business teams.
Strong understanding of application architecture, relational data modeling, APIs, system integration, workflow automation, and software development lifecycle practices.
Experience integrating enterprise SaaS, CRM, database, analytics, and internally developed applications.
Experience managing production systems and balancing feature development with reliability, maintainability, and technical debt.
Ability to evaluate architecture and implementation decisions at meaningful technical depth.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.

Preferred

Experience supporting marketing, demand generation, sales, customer engagement, or revenue operations environments.
Experience with Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle APEX, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or comparable enterprise application technologies.
Experience with cloud services, integration platforms, API gateways, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.
Experience implementing enterprise identity, RBAC/ABAC, audit, and security patterns.
Experience applying generative AI, retrieval, intelligent automation, or machine-learning capabilities within enterprise workflows.
Experience establishing development standards and modernizing internally developed applications.

What Success Looks Like

MarTech applications operate as an increasingly coherent technology ecosystem rather than independent tools.
Engineers have clear technical standards, ownership, priorities, and career development.
Delivery velocity improves while production stability and maintainability increase.
Reusable integrations and shared capabilities replace duplicate implementations.
Manual operational work is systematically reduced through technology and automation.
Marketing teams trust the applications and data supporting their workflows.
The organization can adopt new capabilities, including AI, without bypassing security, architecture, or governance controls.

Lead the transformation of Amazon India's largest financial platform from manual operations to AI-driven autonomous finance, architecting systems where every rupee reconciles at zero-error tolerance across billions in transaction flows. This is a rare opportunity to lead a category-defining financial platform from first principles, influence WW architecture across multiple Amazon organizations, and shape the future of marketplace finance at scale.

Key job responsibilities

As the Sr. SDM for P3P Financial Stack, you will own the technology strategy, execution, and people leadership for this platform at a pivotal moment in its evolution, from high-touch manual operations to AI-driven autonomous finance. You will lead a large engineering team across multiple verticals, driving the technical roadmap for touchless payment systems, agentic financial operations (AI agents that autonomously detect defects, identify root causes, and execute resolutions), intelligent reconciliation, and ERP-agnostic architecture that decouples sellers from 3rd party software dependencies. You will be the single technical voice representing India's financial platform in global forums influencing WW partner roadmaps to adopt India-originated innovations, and partnering with multiple WW organizations to ensure P3P evolves from a local platform into a globally adopted reference architecture. You will translate continuously evolving regulations (GST 2.0, e-invoicing) into executable technical strategies, architect for config-driven zero-code market onboarding, and position P3P as an early adopter of AI-to-AI commerce where vendor and seller AI systems interact programmatically with P3P's payment and reconciliation APIs. Equally, you will raise the engineering bar, mentor the next generation of senior engineers, and build a high-performing team culture that attracts top talent to one of the most complex and consequential financial engineering challenges at Amazon.

About The Team

Amazon India's Seller Partner Services (SPS) Tech builds the technology backbone that enables multi-billion-dollar GMS across Amazon.in's marketplace. Within IN SPS Tech, the P3P Financial Stack technologies enables P3P sellers to operate within a pure marketplace architecture. P3P Tech makes retail-grade financial tools available to a class of sellers and vendors via a financial platform built entirely from the ground up owning the complete financial lifecycle from Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable to Tax Compliance, Vendor Payments, General Ledger Accounting, and Reconciliation across thousands of vendors and millions of ASINs. This platform's capabilities match or exceed those of multiple specialized WW organizations.
